tabs.label: Passing
tabs.guide: +1 per 25 yards, +4 TD, +0.1 per completion, +1 3rd-down conv, +2 4th-down conv; -2 INT, -2 fumble, -0.5 sacked

tabs.label: Rushing
tabs.guide: +1 per 10 yards, +6 TD, +0.25 first down, +1 per 20+ yd run, +1 3rd-down, +2 4th-down; -2 fumble

tabs.label: Receiving
tabs.guide: +1 per 10 yards, +6 TD, +0.5 per catch, +0.25 first down, +1 3rd-down, +2 4th-down

tabs.label: D-Line
tabs.guide: +4 sack, +1.5 TFL, +0.75 tackle, +0.5 QB hit, +0.25 pressure, +4 safety, +6 TD

tabs.label: Secondary
tabs.guide: +5 INT, +6 pick six, +1 TU, +0.75 tackle, +0.5 per incompletion forced (target not caught); -1 per 33 yards allowed, -3 TD allowed

tabs.label: Kicking
tabs.guide: +3 per made field goal, -1 per miss
